detail.longDescription: For almost a year now, I've been screaming at my home server because it would start my # Forgejo # container before the network interfaces it uses were up. I tried a few things to fix it but eventually gave up. Only today did I discover that there is a # kernel parameter called `ip_nonlocal_bind` which prevents just this problem by allowing processes to bind to non-existent addresses. They thought of everything! # Linux # HomeServer # SelfHosting # SelfHosted
